headline: Polish Debt Manager Kruk Group to Lay Off 10% of Workforce
summary: Grupa Kruk announced group redundancies affecting 150 employees, representing approximately 10% of its workforce after the new year.
why: Kruk Group is one of Central Europe's largest debt management and non-performing loan portfolio recovery companies.

impacts.name: KRUK
impacts.why: Kruk announced a 10% workforce reduction to reduce administrative expenses.
